name: BLOX
summary:
Blox is your ultimate VR playground for creativity. Grab a handful of blocks and start building anything you can imagine—castles, towers, cities, or something totally wild. There are no rules, no missions, no limits. Just you, your ideas, and endless blocks to play with.
